coverage.mechanism: Synthetic data declared globally.
Shared prompts compile full brief obligations.
Gated identity, account lookup, negotiation, and terminal stage.
Only supplied call inputs initialize context; account comes from API.
Customer ID is bound to tools; date policy uses supplied now.
Fixed opening states bank assistant and recorded call; preverification restrictions in prompt.
Fixed titled identity question.
Explicit confirmation semantics, second ask, and unclear close route.
Opening dialogue handles AI/robot question.
Third-party disclosure and callback prompt.
Map schedule_callback data.ok and add a deterministic success route to close_stage.
One invalid-slot retry, then no_callback.
Wrong-number terminal disposition.
Required sympathy and no further questions.
Relative barred from security and account disclosure.
Ordered security questions and API answer binding.
Cumulative wrong-answer result handling.
Actual swap hint prompts worded-month retry.
Route to close_stage when verify_identity reports wrong_answers_left equal to zero.
One security explanation then declined disposition.
Account API request only after identity-state route.
Post-lookup disclosure includes product, amount, lateness.
Date kernel excludes weekends and supplied holidays.
Date kernel selects late band by days late.
Kernel calculates 12th/7th business-day deadlines and 1/2 attempts.
Prompt validates today-to-deadline business date.
Prompt moves eligible nonbusiness date to next business day.
One exact-date clarification then deadline proposal.
Calendar-week weekday interpretation specified.
After-deadline proposal offers deadline and refusal uses persuasion.
Full amount asked first; prohibited phrasing stated.
Product-specific floor mapping stated.
Floor offer once, remainder overdue, late second offer.
Inclusive range acceptance and below-floor handling.
Required first payment-today question.
Proposals are not refusals; validation follows.
Bounded persuasion dates, amounts, and attempts.
Exhaustion stops repeated offers and selects refused.
Map transfer_to_agent data.ok and add a receipt-based terminal route.
Prohibits unauthorized concessions and terms.
Read-back and clear confirmation gate create_promise.
Changed terms must be revalidated and read back.
One immutable recorded promise per product; app guidance.
Map promise_id and data.ok, and gate the terminal route on a successful promise receipt or transfer receipt.
Required post-recording SMS statement.
Paid response and no-promise branch.
Disputes and past product status take no-promise path.
Restructuring queue transfer; no plan description.
One help offer, then general transfer on insistence.
Bank customer-service verification advice.
Unknown answer response forbids invention.
Repeated unwillingness disposition depends on verified state.
Exactly one legal close tool precedes native termination.
Outcome/reason allowlist and source evidence gates.
Transfer reason supersedes promise outcome after recorded promise.
No add_note operation is defined or exposed.
Thank-you and goodbye instruction precedes close tool.

limitations: The workflow still does not deterministically count promise attempts or route a second unsuccessful create_promise result to no_promise/service_error; the source requires one retry and that closure.

Transfer success is not correlated to the current requested queue, and a shared transfer_result_ok can remain stale across actions; the new route therefore does not fully establish the required transfer disposition.

Opening callback and transfer success routes reach close_stage without deterministic trusted outcome/reason state; the existing disposition code depends on policy_outcome and receipt state variables that this patch does not populate.
Identity refusal counts and unclear-confirmation counts remain semantic/prose driven rather than maintained as trusted deterministic state.
The close_call unsuccessful route still returns to a node that exposes close_call again, with no source-defined reconciliation for a failed close.
